visual_action: A rapid slideshow of still photographs. The photos include a shot of Joe Biden seated at a table with an American flag in the background, a close-up of Hunter Biden, a photo of Joe Biden and Donald Trump together, and other photos of political figures.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: Appears in multiple photographs throughout the slideshow, and as President, is the central figure of the @whitehouse account.

cast.name: Hunter Biden
cast.evidence: A close-up photograph of him is included in the slideshow.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Appears in a photograph next to Joe Biden while wearing a red hat.

spoken_summary: There is no spoken audio, only instrumental music.
audio_music: The audio is the instrumental from the song "Hotline Bling" by Drake, a popular song often used in memes and on social media.
editing_pacing: The video is a slideshow of still images with quick cuts between photos, timed to the beat of the music.
central_claim: The video associates President Biden with his son and his chief political rival through a montage of images set to a popular meme song.
intended_effect: To generate discussion and social media engagement by using a popular but tonally ambiguous meme format with politically-charged imagery from an official source.
uncertainty_flags: The video's central message and intent are highly ambiguous due to the unusual combination of imagery (Joe Biden, Hunter Biden, Donald Trump), the official source (@whitehouse), and the chosen song.
